Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Pallavi Sethi. I am a 41-year-old paediatrician living in Lucknow. I have a tenancy problem with Arjun Sathe involving Rs 1,95,000 in rent, and the tenant has stopped paying rent for many months. My case number is R.C.A. No. 999/2019 in the Lucknow District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 79982 66993 or email pallavi.sethi@example.in.
